panels.description: Object storage operations issued by queriers, by operation. Operations with no requests in the selected time range are hidden. Only available with the Thanos object storage client (use_thanos_objstore: true).
panels.title: Object storage operations

panels.description: p99, p90 and p50 latency of a single object storage operation as seen by the client, by operation, including any retries the client does internally.
panels.title: Object storage latency

panels.description: Total time a (sub)query spent downloading chunks, across all of its chunk fetches. This is not the latency of a single GET: see "Object storage latency" for that.
panels.title: Chunk download latency (per query)

panels.description: HTTP requests to object storage that got a non-2xx response, by status code. Status codes with no requests in the selected time range are hidden. Every HTTP attempt is counted, including retries done inside the client. 429 and 503 (orange) are throttling, for example S3 SlowDown; other 5xx (red) are server errors; 404 (grey) is object not found. Requests that failed without an HTTP response are not counted here.
panels.title: Object storage HTTP errors

panels.description: Retries done by congestion control. These cover chunk GETs only. "GETs failed after retries" counts GETs that still failed after the last allowed retry; the error is returned to the query. Without congestion control the object storage client retries internally, and those retries are not counted by any metric.
panels.title: Object storage congestion control retries

panels.description: Average time a chunk GET attempt waited for the AIMD rate limiter before it was sent, across all queriers. This is not a delay between retries: retries are sent as soon as the rate limiter allows.
panels.title: Object storage wait due to congestion control
